Current preflight covers the live gate input Qf and other stated input/output spans. Keep Qf/qsa_Qfull16 untouched; the gate reads it after selection and writes attn_h.

Capability validation is late and the opt-in branch does not fall back to the existing scorer. Unsupported Level Zero/FP16 can throw after KV/indexer state writes; current fail-closed behavior also conflicts with R1039's retain-old-path-on-guard-failure recommendation.

Status is read after a checked whole-layer drain, following use by that layer's top-k/attention/gate. The call returns failure before successful prefill/decode exposure. Add an earlier checked boundary only if immediate pre-attention rejection is required.

The test source has correct Buffer/Drain host DMA lifetime and canary layout; its source does not qualify actual runtime behavior. FP16 GEMM scores may differ from FP32; only the control and dead-key score require exact score bits.
